name: catalog-date-field-binding
proves: isoDate typed marker (recalibration section 10.1/10.2): a date-field descriptor whose DateValue library type is converted at the adapter boundary only; the document persists 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings; '' is the empty convention

outputs.name: valueChange
outputs.description: Fires with the selected calendar date, or '' when the field is cleared.

expected: picking 2026-10-08 writes state.deliveryDate = '2026-10-08' (string, no timezone conversion — the catalog.test.ts discipline); clearing the field writes ''; the adapter maps '' to undefined for the library prop; a literal like '10/08/2026' is rejected at authoring time (format rule); value survives save/reload and drives the finished app
